description: Returns everything Spekkr knows about one spec: its manifest (what it builds, what the person may change under customize, the files, what it needs, the commands and secrets it uses under safety, the changelog). Read it before pull_spec to learn which choices the spec offers. versions says which versions Spekkr keeps; give version to read a kept one that is not the newest. related lists a few specs like this one: each is another spec, with its own id, and none is part of this one. forks names up to twelve specs that members forked from it and changed, one for each member, and forksTotal counts every fork. It also says how often the spec was pulled and starred (pulls, pullsThisWeek, stars), each left out when zero, and the day its newest version was published (updated), which a spec Spekkr lists itself does not have.

version.description: A kept version to read, like 1.4.0. Leave it out for the newest.

name: get_spec
title: Read a spec's listing
